There are three books published in Indonesian by Mizan Pustaka under the English title '''The Wheel of Time'''  with the book titles also partially in English. The only books published are:

# The Eye of the World (2010) 
# The Great Hunt: Perburuan Sangkakala (2013?) - Hunt for the Horn
# The Great Hunt: Sang Peniup Sangkakala (2013) - Hornsounder

Translations were made by Femmy Syahrani and Dina Begum.
